name: TorqueShield
subtitle: Repair, VIN & lease workspace
promotionalText: Organize vehicle repair-estimate decisions, VIN checks and lease-mileage assumptions.
description:
Organize vehicle repair-estimate decisions, VIN checks and lease-mileage assumptions.

Import a repair estimate and inspect line items against the source wording.

Record accepted, declined or undecided items without inventing a market-price benchmark.

Check a 17-character VIN checksum and review the limits of repeating model-year codes.

Project lease mileage using the actual lease start, allowance and current odometer assumptions.

Search your saved library locally. Export a complete portable backup with optional password encryption; imports add new identifiers and keep existing edited records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and supported Apple Intelligence generation run on device. Optional storage uses your private iCloud container. There is no developer-operated account, advertising, analytics backend or third-party AI API. Supported local/text workflows remain available when a model or speech language is unavailable.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five successful on-device AI actions in total per app. Reading, editing, exporting and backing up saved records remain available without Pro. Pro unlocks additional actions through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. App Store prices, eligibility and subscription terms are displayed before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

A checksum is not a vehicle-history, ownership or safety certification, and VIN requirements differ by market. Repair review does not certify a fair price or replace a qualified mechanic. Lease projections exclude condition charges, taxes, fees and market changes.
